your_games.title: 🦋 Hollow Knight: Silksong's free Sea of Sorrow expansion arrives on 11 December
your_games.body: Team Cherry used Friday's Cherry Time broadcast to date Silksong's first expansion, which is free for everyone who owns the game. Hornet voyages above and beneath Pharloom's forgotten ocean, across islands, forts and deep caverns, with new bosses, more Christopher Larkin music, cannon-launching traversal and even silk-fishing. Team Cherry calls it "unlike anything we've done before", and it looks far bigger than any of Hollow Knight's free DLCs.

your_games.title: ⚡ Pokémon GO links up with Pokémon Champions from 8 December
your_games.body: A week after Champions' 2 December update, bringing Pokémon you befriended in GO to Champions as visitors earns a one-off Professor Willow Outfit Set and up to 10 Training Tickets between 8 and 18 December, on Switch and mobile. GO runs a Champions Celebration Event from 8 to 14 December with Charmander, Starly, Grookey, Absol and Gible in the wild and more Kecleon at PokéStops.

your_games.title: 🪐 Warframe's Tau update on 9 December is "practically Warframe 2", says Digital Extremes
your_games.body: Tau adds a whole second solar system with a roughly two-hour story quest, a new navigation system and two regions at launch: the hazard-filled World-Seeder Oasis and the ringed city of Fornax with three hubs. Spy missions and Steel Path return, there's a card game, an on-rails driving minigame between hubs and a no-combat Night Walk mode where you walk a dog.

your_games.title: 🐝 Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair's Definitive Edition skips Xbox because of cost
your_games.body: Playtonic says technical challenges and costs mean the 15 December upgrade, with 120fps, reworked lighting and the Trowzer's Top Tonic Pack DLC, is coming only to PS5, Switch 2 and PC for the foreseeable future. Digital Foundry's John Linneman points out the Xbox One X version already runs at native 4K.

your_games.title: 🎭 Rayman Legends Retold aims for 60fps on Switch 2, but the Mario and Luigi costumes are gone
your_games.body: Creative director Loïc Gounon says Ubisoft built the Switch 2 version in parallel with the others and gave it "extra love", targeting 60fps docked and handheld, with GameShare for the Kung Foot mode. The Wii U-era plumber outfits won't return, though other surprise costumes are promised. It's out on 3 December.

your_games.title: 🐉 Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World explains why Debora isn't a playable heroine
your_games.body: Producer Takuma Shiraishi says Debora was considered alongside Bianca and Nera, but Yuji Horii narrowed it to two because she first appeared in the DS remake, not the SNES original. She still plays a big part in the story as her younger self. The game is out on 3 December.

your_games.title: 🌱 Pokémon Winds & Waves' three starters get their first plush toys
your_games.body: Browt, Pombon and Gecqua plushies go on sale at Pokémon Centers in Japan on 5 December for ¥2,200 each, with no word on other regions yet. The game itself still has no date beyond a simultaneous worldwide launch in 2027.

your_games.title: 🚀 Space RPG Exodus reveals PC specs ahead of its 7 April launch
your_games.body: The Mass Effect-like RPG needs an i5-10400 or Ryzen 5 3600, an RTX 2060 or RX 6600 and 16GB of RAM for 1080p at 30fps, an RTX 3080 or RX 7700 XT for 1440p at 60fps, and an RTX 5080 or RX 9070 XT with 32GB for 4K at 60fps. Plan for 110GB of SSD space.

your_games.title: 🦾 EA Motive's refreshed website hints Iron Man could show up at The Game Awards
your_games.body: Fans spotted a makeover on the studio's site two weeks before the 10 December show, which streams on Disney+ for the first time with Disney promising major announcements. Nothing is confirmed, but the timing lines up with Avengers: Doomsday opening eight days later.

industry.title: Story of Seasons and Rune Factory maker Marvelous offers early retirement to cut 65 jobs
industry.body: Marvelous will accept voluntary resignations from full-time and contract staff between 14 December and 8 January, with a lump-sum payout and job-hunting support, as it restructures its console and PC division. It says larger projects and longer development cycles are changing the market, and it will lean more on external partners.

industry.title: GTA VI sells over 200,000 boxed copies in its first days in Japan
industry.body: Famitsu's chart for 16 to 22 November puts the PS5 version at 200,759 physical sales from its 19 November launch, more than five times second-placed Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 (35,295 that week, 658,433 in total).

industry.title: The rumoured Simpsons: Hit & Run remake may have been cancelled
industry.body: A senior designer at New Radical Games, revived by Radical Entertainment veterans, says its unannounced "mind-blowingly awesome" project was caught in "a whole gaggle of cancellations", in a LinkedIn post laced with Simpsons quotes. The studio never announced what it was making, but Matt Groening hinted this summer that Hit & Run was coming back.

industry.title: Modern Warfare 4 sends Call of Duty HQ to the top of Newzoo's October PC revenue chart
industry.body: Call of Duty HQ also reached second on console behind EA Sports FC 27. Phantom Blade Zero was the only other new release in the console top ten at No.8, while Cyberpunk 2077 climbed 51 places on PC after its Edgerunners 2 update.

industry.title: EA sells new Dragon Age merch weeks after closing BioWare
industry.body: A Dragon Age: Inquisition hoodie on the BioWare Gear store follows criticism of new Mass Effect merch on N7 Day. EA shut BioWare and cancelled Mass Effect 5 in October, and a petition to save the series has passed 330,000 signatures.

industry.title: Rockstar has "not had a lot of conversations" about setting GTA outside the US
industry.body: Co-studio head Rob Nelson told Eurogamer the US keeps changing and gives Rockstar plenty to respond to, and that Florida was chosen quickly for GTA VI as the one big setting it hadn't revisited recently.
